Panel output (deprecated)

Source: R/panel_output.R
panel_output.Rd

panel_output() was renamed to confirmation_panel() in shinyGovstyle 0.3.0, with main_text becoming title and sub_text becoming content. The output is unchanged. panel_output() will be removed in shinyGovstyle 1.0.0.

Usage

panel_output(inputId, main_text, sub_text)

Arguments

inputId

The id assigned to the component's root element. For Shiny input components this is also the name used to access the value via input$<inputId>.

main_text

Use confirmation_panel(title) instead.

sub_text

Use confirmation_panel(content) instead.

Value

a panel HTML shiny tag object

Examples

# Before
# panel_output("panel1", main_text = "Application complete",
#   sub_text = "Your reference is xvsiq")

# After
confirmation_panel(
  "panel1",
  title = "Application complete",
  content = "Your reference is xvsiq"
)
#> <div class="govuk-panel govuk-panel--confirmation" id="panel1">
#>   <h1 class="govuk-panel__title">Application complete</h1>
#>   <div class="govuk-panel__body">Your reference is xvsiq</div>
#> </div>
